items.name: ask-matt
techniques: Choose a conditional flow rather than keyword-only skill name matching; verify actual method before recommending omission
Context decision tree: continue, irrelevant-context clear, portable handoff, scoped delegation, then compaction at phase boundaries; preserve primary-source reasoning when next phase needs it
items.adaptation: Andino owns routing/lifecycle; remove ask-matt router, fixed token smart-zone numbers, mandatory context resets and upstream native skill calls.

items.name: codebase-design
techniques: Interface includes invariants, ordering, configuration, errors and performance, beyond signatures
Depth means leverage; deletion test distinguishes pass-through from concentrated complexity; locality confines changes
Interface is test surface; real variation justifies two adapters; internal seams need not leak publicly
Classify dependencies as in-process, local-substitutable, remote-owned ports/adapters or true external mocks
Replace obsolete shallow tests with interface tests after equivalent coverage exists

Design-it-twice compares three distinct interfaces optimized for minimal surface, flexibility and common caller, optionally ports/adapters; outputs usage, hidden implementation, invariants and trade-offs
items.adaptation: Reference technique under Andino, no autonomous full scan; alternatives can be sequential when delegation unavailable.

items.name: code-review
techniques: Separate Standards and Spec axes so a passing axis cannot mask a failing one
Pin base and exact diff, validate ref/non-empty, discover spec by commits/path/convention then ask
Load all project standards including CODING_STANDARDS and CONTRIBUTING; repo overrides Fowler smell heuristics; skip tooling-enforced findings

Twelve smell baseline: Mysterious Name, Duplicated Code, Feature Envy, Data Clumps, Primitive Obsession, Repeated Switches, Shotgun Surgery, Divergent Change, Speculative Generality, Message Chains, Middle Man, Refused Bequest
Findings cite rule or spec and actual hunk; absent spec is reported, not invented
items.adaptation: Freeze working-tree diff when commits are unauthorized: original three-dot HEAD excludes uncommitted changes. Leaf reviewers only, verify claims, bounded focused repair review; no recursive native calls.

items.name: diagnosing-bugs
techniques: Redact commands/artifacts before display; keep credentials in environment
Establish one already-run exact-symptom red-capable deterministic fast loop before hypothesizing
Loop options: failing test, HTTP/CLI, browser, trace replay, harness, seeded fuzz, bisect, differential, HITL last resort
Raise flaky repro rate, minimize one input at a time until each remaining piece is load-bearing
Rank 3-5 falsifiable hypotheses, vary one factor, use debugger before targeted tagged logs; performance baseline/profiler then bisect
Test at seam reproducing actual caller pattern; if no seam exists document limitation; prove forced mutation with diff
Rerun original scenario, remove tagged instrumentation and account for throwaway artifacts
items.adaptation: Bound depth by actual complexity and preserve existing repro evidence; never require live/production access. HITL template prints observations, never secrets.

items.name: domain-modeling
techniques: Challenge overloaded vocabulary against code and glossary; stress-test concrete edge scenarios
Capture resolved terms inline as tight definitions and avoided aliases, no implementation details
Root glossary or contextual glossary map, create lazily only on actual content
ADR only if hard to reverse, surprising and real trade-off; small numbered decision record, optional status/options/consequences
items.adaptation: Existing project glossary/ADR location and conventions override seed templates; Andino checkpoint stores operational decisions.

items.name: grill-with-docs
techniques: Stateful interview composes decision-tree interviewing with inline domain terms and qualified ADR recording
items.adaptation: Substantive composed procedures must be local, no thin wrapper or two native skill calls; retain non-ADR decisions in Andino checkpoint/spec.

items.name: implement
techniques: Fetch explicit ticket from configured tracker, state title and resolve ambiguity
Drive test-first public-seam slices, run targeted tests and typechecks during work, full suite at completion, review resulting diff
items.adaptation: Andino lifecycle and acceptance control execution; remove automatic commit and upstream native calls.

items.name: implement-spec
techniques: Read ticket blockers as graph; dispatch ready frontier and update it from accepted integrated work
Share spec/research pointers rather than duplicating context; optional exploration isolates reading from implementation
One integration result and final spec review after all dependent tickets, one bounded finding repair pass
items.adaptation: No automatic branch, reset, merge, commit, push, draft PR or ticket close. Explicit file ownership and actual host authority gate delegation; compute progress independently of stale remote closed counters.

items.name: improve-codebase-architecture
techniques: Scope by user direction or recent change hotspots before scanning; locate friction and apply deletion test
Produce before/after candidate visuals with files, problem, solution, leverage/locality, testability, dependency class, strength and ADR conflict
Recommend one candidate, let user choose before designing interface; record durable rejected alternatives
items.adaptation: Report offline inline CSS/SVG instead of mandatory CDN Tailwind/Mermaid; keep survey bounded and acknowledge no worthwhile findings. Existing UI owner controls presentation.

items.name: pr
techniques: Smallest useful summary view: pseudocode, call/component/file tree, Mermaid or shaped diff
Concrete before/after evidence and one-way/two-way door plus blast radius
PR body technique only, not creation or publication authority
items.adaptation: Repo PR template wins; retain CREDITS.md attribution to Dex Horthy/Humanlayer show-me; risk call must include irreversible external effects beyond Git rollback.

items.name: prototype
techniques: One explicit unresolved design question; memory/scratch state and obvious prototype label, trivial run path
Logic path: self-contained HTML, pure portable state module separate from DOM, full readable state, free play and resettable guided scenarios
UI path: 3 structurally distinct variants (max 5), existing route preferred, URL variant and shared keyboard switcher, preserve inputs/auth; no real mutations
Capture answer and primary-source artifact, then properly implement validated decision
items.adaptation: No new prototype branch/commit required or authorized. Store local evidence under existing conventions; prototype constraints never substitute production checks; UI direction remains existing sibling owner.

items.name: research
techniques: Investigate official docs/source/specs/first-party APIs, trace every factual claim to owning primary source
Write one cited findings artifact in existing convention with context pointer for consumer
items.adaptation: Delegate only if available/allowed; leaf execution does actual reading rather than respawning research. Retain dates, uncertainty and verify citations.

items.name: retro
techniques: Use actual selected session evidence, ranked environment improvements rather than speculative code rewrites
Inspect existing checks and CI before proposing new guardrails; mechanical violations become deterministic checks, judgment calls become review standards
Navigation, hidden dependencies, steering no-ops, tool economy, access limitations; remove/move bloated always-loaded instructions
Agent-document authoring definitions needed even in read-only retrospective
items.adaptation: No mandatory retrospective every task, no global instruction edit or new access grant without authority; every finding cites session evidence and existing tooling.

items.name: setup-matt-pocock-skills
techniques: Inspect actual remote/instructions/tracker/docs and existing conventions before configuration
Capture issue-tracker operations for GitHub, GitLab, local markdown or described custom tracker; map canonical triage roles
Preserve existing instruction blocks/user edits, create domain docs lazily, verify label availability
Tracker templates cover read/list/subissue/native blockers/frontier/claim/resolve and textual fallback
items.adaptation: Optional repository configuration method, never installer/bootstrap/precondition for Andino. No automatic labels, external write, global configuration or mandatory upstream installation. Active host decides instruction pointer file.

items.name: tdd
techniques: Agree observable public seams and record catch/miss trade-offs before tests
One red test and minimal green implementation vertically per cycle
Behavioral specification tests survive internal changes; no private-method/internal-collaborator assertions or database side-channel verification
Independent literal/spec oracle avoids tautological expectations; external boundary mocking via injected specific operation interfaces
items.adaptation: Canonical Andino TDD must explicitly reconcile Matt review-only refactoring versus other upstream green refactor. Existing accepted seams can satisfy agreement; no repeated permission gate on already-authorized routine checks.

items.name: to-spec
techniques: Synthesize settled conversation without repeating interview; inspect repo, glossary and ADRs
Prefer highest existing seam, state test decisions and scope
Problem/solution/user stories/implementation decisions/testing/out-of-scope/further notes; decision-rich prototype snippets may be included
Durable interface/behavior decisions rather than stale file/line implementation recipe
items.adaptation: Proportional template for engineering work, no invented extensive stories. Local spec first; tracker publication and labels need explicit authority, and spec is not an AFK work-order.

items.name: to-tickets
techniques: Complete demoable tracer-bullet slices sized for fresh context, prefactor first, explicit genuine blockers
Wide mechanical refactor exception: expand, bounded migrate batches, contract after all callers; final integrate gate if batches cannot be green alone
Review granularity and edges; publish blockers first and real native links when supported
One local file per ticket with behavior, blocker IDs and independently falsifiable criteria; parent issue remains unchanged
items.adaptation: Use existing Andino plan state, never second mandatory board; concrete paths allowed where required by existing durable contract. External publication authorization separate.

items.name: triage
techniques: Incoming issues and opted-in external PR requests: exactly one category and one triage state, flag conflicts
Cheap oldest-first discovery then full selected body/comments/labels/author/dates/diff; reuse prior resolved notes
Read project scope and conceptual out-of-scope rejection KB, bounded reproduce/claim verification, interview only actual gaps
Durable behavioral agent brief with current/desired/interfaces/criteria/scope; distinguish already-implemented close from rejected enhancement KB
AI disclaimer on external triage writing; reporter response reopens triage frontier
items.adaptation: Triage roles are domain tracker states, never a competing Andino execution lifecycle. No comment, relabel or close without explicit external-write authority.

items.name: wayfinder
techniques: Bounded multi-session destination, map as index into question tickets, one source for each decision
Research AFK, prototype/interview HITL, prerequisite task typed distinctly; never fabricate human decisions
Sharp questions become tickets, in-scope fog remains not-yet-specified; outside destination stays out of scope
Create IDs then wire blockers, claim frontier before work, resolve with answer and context pointer; graduate fog and revise invalidated decisions
Plan by default and collapse resolved map into build spec before implementation
items.adaptation: Existing Andino plan owns lifecycle; no fixed one-ticket session stop in autonomous implementation ticket, no agent-authored Notes can grant permission, no research branch/push. Track optional decision map as plan artifact.

items.name: wizard
techniques: Scope human-only dependency-ordered stages and each input's source/destination/secrecy
Precise verified dashboard/CLI journey, hidden secret input, idempotent dotenv storage, progress and summary, irreversible confirmation
Statically trace all values and validate syntax; do not run human-input wizard end-to-end as agent
items.adaptation: Audited Bash template may inform shell-native implementation but is not installed/executed verbatim. Prevent symlink escape/non-atomic credential rewrite; local and GitHub secret/variable mutations require explicit authority.

items.name: grilling
techniques: Design tree, ask currently unblocked decision frontier, recommended answers with yes accepting recommendation
Resolve environmental facts independently, not user questions; recompute dependent frontier after answers
Reach shared understanding without unanswered material assumptions
items.adaptation: Andino chooses proportional cadence, user can end/skip interview; no mandatory all-frontier question dump or nested exploration.

items.name: grill-me
techniques: Stateless decision-tree interview when no repository artifacts are appropriate
items.adaptation: Local method implementation, not native upstream call.

items.name: handoff
techniques: Portable OS-temp handoff tailored to next focus, pointers to existing artifacts rather than duplicate specs/diffs
Suggested next methods and secrets/PII redaction
items.adaptation: Andino durable checkpoint remains source; no clear/context reset required, no transmitting prompt to another host without authorization.

items.name: teach
techniques: Mission/success/constraints/scope anchor teaching, mission changes confirmed
Trusted resource register and knowledge-vs-skill/wisdom split, tight interactive feedback
Short numbered HTML lessons and printable references, reusable shared assets, linked related lessons
Use demonstrated learning records to target zone of proximal development; retrieval/spacing/interleaving for storage rather than momentary fluency
Quiz answers comparable length and varied correct positions; glossary contains understood concepts, supersede corrected records
items.adaptation: Workspace-relative output separate from package resources; no unsolicited scheduled automation or joining communities, no claim of learning from coverage alone.

items.name: to-questionnaire
techniques: Interview send: recipient expertise/relationship and decisions/facts needed, rather than ask sender unknown subject facts
Most-important-first discover questions, one idea each, answer stubs, purpose/context/how answers used, deadline/effort and uncertainty allowed
Coverage check each requested decision gap has a question
items.adaptation: Produce local reviewable document only; sending requires user authority.

items.name: wait-what
techniques: Re-explain last confusing message with missing context, simplified language and project glossary vocabulary
items.adaptation: Repitch the previous message under Focus communication ownership using existing context and domain vocabulary; no new investigation, tool dependency, unsolicited file edit or second lifecycle.

items.name: writing-for-agents
techniques: Context pointers state resource and distinct trigger branches, front-load leading concept
Separate ordered actions from reference; disclose branch-only resources and co-locate each concept's rules/caveats
Checkable exhaustive step completion bounds counter premature completion; split only when hierarchy/context boundary earns cost
One authoritative meaning; prune environment-cache duplication, stale sediment and model-relative no-op instructions
Positive target behavior plus hard guardrails; distinct context cost and human cognitive cost
items.adaptation: Mechanics resource becomes guide/index design under one native Andino SKILL; no native skill proliferation/router authority.

items.name: git-guardrails-claude-code
techniques: Identify destructive/publishing Git actions and scoped pre-execution interception
Preserve existing hook arrays and validate rejection fixture
items.adaptation: Original regex Bash/jq hook fails open and misses global-option spellings; never claim complete enforcement or copy unchanged. Host permission layer remains authority; optional project-only hook after explicit scope approval.

items.name: migrate-to-shoehorn
techniques: Test-only partial fixture migration: as Typeâ†’fromPartial, intentionally malformed double assertionâ†’fromAny, fromExact for full objects
Inspect actual fixture needs, preserve negative test intent, add imports and run typecheck plus affected tests
items.adaptation: Use detected package manager, devDependency and current official API verification before installation; never apply to production or claim casts become runtime validation.

items.name: scaffold-exercises
techniques: Number section XX and exercise XX.YY directories, explicit problem/solution/explainer variants
Non-empty linked readmes; code variants main.ts, readme-only permitted; no .gitkeep/speaker-notes/dead links
Validate course linter if installed; renumber intentionally preserving content
items.adaptation: No implicit ai-hero-cli install or commit/stage/git mv; use repo conventions and portable filesystem moves under authority.

items.name: setup-pre-commit
techniques: Detect package manager and existing scripts/config; staged-only formatter before typecheck/tests
Husky+lint-staged+Prettier optional recipe, preserve existing formatting conventions, omit missing scripts explicitly
Verify hook invocation and staged lint behavior without committing
items.adaptation: Merge hooks and prepare script rather than overwrite, no auto stage/commit or global install; use disposable fixture for lint-staged to preserve user staging.

items.name: chief-of-staff
techniques: Distinguish tactical goal progress from future environment improvement; context pointer handoffs
items.adaptation: Exclude always-delegate, recurring schedules, environment-first on every message and no-workaround universal policy: conflicts with proportional Andino lifecycle, tool limits and permission scope.

items.name: claude-handoff
techniques: Named background continuation seeded by redacted OS-temp summary and context pointers
items.adaptation: No hardcoded claude --bg shell execution. Only supported current host adapter after explicit delegation authority; if unavailable keep file-based handoff and report actual mode.

items.name: loop-me
techniques: Find recurring patterns and specify trigger (event preferred where efficient), human checkpoint, late decision-ready brief
One workflow spec each, world/tool/vocabulary notes first if needed; no structural schedule/AI/checkpoint requirement
Done when implementer can build without unresolved material questions
items.adaptation: Workflow specification is user artifact, never creates recurring automation or second agent lifecycle by itself.

items.name: setup-ts-deep-modules
techniques: Flat packages with all root files public entrypoints, all subfolders private, avoid giant barrels
Five actual dependency-cruiser rules: outside-app entrypoint, cross-package entrypoint, tests through entrypoints, tests-folder private, no cycles
Intra-package implementation free imports, tests may use only public root and own test fixtures
Detect manager/root/existing config, merge and wire umbrella check; preserve tsconfig/no new aliases
Disposable clean passâ†’deep-import failâ†’restore pass proves rules bite; document copyable example and pointer
items.adaptation: Source prose says four rules, config actually five; preserve five and prove each applicable negative. Dependency install/project edits authorized per task, no commit or global setup.

items.name: writing-beats
techniques: Audience prerequisites and grounded-concept frontier; candidate reachable beats state newly grounded concepts
Offer 2-3 structurally different openings/next beats; user chooses, write only selected beat, reread disk each time
End when journey complete rather than raw pile exhausted; preserve edits and narrow rewrite scope
items.adaptation: Keep beat path distinct from paragraph-shaping path; no automatic choice for human or publication.

items.name: writing-fragments
techniques: Explore heterogeneous raw fragments, including leading metaphors, without premature outline
Single working-title document with horizontal-rule fragments, capture from initial prompt
Reread before append, preserve user edits, targeted revisions only when requested
items.adaptation: No speculative article structure or sending/publishing; destination selected by user or existing convention.

items.name: writing-shape
techniques: Read fixed raw material end-to-end, keep it read-only and write separate article
Set audience grounded concepts; 2-3 thesis openings and deliberate argument/form choice per block
Prose vs parallel list, callout vs inline, repeated-fields table, quote vs paraphrase and block vs inline code tradeoffs
Name missing material rather than invent it; reread destination before each agreed append, user decides completion
items.adaptation: Keep paragraph/block path distinct from choose-next-beat path; no raw-source edit, publishing or unrequested metadata.

items.name: resolving-merge-conflicts
techniques: Archived human docs retain historical role-aware conflict advice; no actual SKILL.md or current runtime capability
items.adaptation: Inventory historical removed item only; do not activate retired skill or execute merge/rebase.

conflicts.conflict: Matt explicitly excludes refactoring from redâ†’green and assigns it to review; other upstream TDD may permit green refactor.
conflicts.resolution_required: Canonical owner must state exact green-state refactor versus separate architectural-review boundary.

conflicts.conflict: Automatic commit/new branches/merge/reset/push/staging and external tracker writes exceed current user authority.
conflicts.resolution_required: Preserve technical procedures; central Andino permission contract controls all side effects.

conflicts.conflict: Second router, setup gate, always-delegate lifecycle and self-authored Notes permission.
conflicts.resolution_required: Absorb bounded techniques into existing Andino route/plan/lifecycle; user instructions are sole permission source.

conflicts.conflict: Recursive delegation, hardcoded tool/native skills, mandatory fan-out and absent sequential fallback.
conflicts.resolution_required: Host capability checks, leaf agents, ownership bounds and truthful sequential fallback.

conflicts.conflict: Bash/jq regex hook fails open and can miss git -C push; not security enforcement.
conflicts.resolution_required: Adapt safety classification under host permissions; any optional hook must fail closed on parser failure and have explicit limitations/negative tests.

conflicts.conflict: CDN scripts violate mandatory offline self-containment, mermaid securityLevel loose.
conflicts.resolution_required: Inline local CSS/SVG rendering, escape untrusted source text; no runtime network dependency.

conflicts.conflict: Human docs state already-fixed redaction/labels/tool wording absent; beta setup claims no rule despite actual config; tdd short description still red-green-refactor.
conflicts.resolution_required: Actual SKILL/resource/config wins; retain docs as observed failure evidence, never current authority.

legal.additional_attribution: PR Summary visuals copied from Dex Horthy / Humanlayer show-me. Preserve named attribution and source links. Snapshot contains no separate license for that cited source; this audit does not assert independently verified remote ownership/license.
legal.lockfile_note: package-lock.json dev-dependency licenses are build provenance, not bundled runtime libraries.

dependency_policy: No upstream installers, global links, automatic update or plugin runtime required. Node/Changesets belong to upstream build only. Conditional methods inspect actual project tools and verify current third-party APIs before changes.
audit_limitations: This is an audit/mapping proposal, not implementation or live-host verification.
No upstream code was executed, installed, updated or modified.
Local snapshot completeness is checked against tracked tree and local files; remote HEAD parity is not claimed.
Human docs are secondary and contain stale claims; actual skills/resources read in full, human docs unique FAQ/acceptance sections inspected.

canonical_comparative_decisions.tdd: RED then GREEN, one public-seam behavior per slice. Optional behavior-preserving GREEN-only refactor gate owned by review; architectural redesign is separate. Accepted interfaces satisfy seam agreement; ask only material unresolved interface choices.
canonical_comparative_decisions.interview: Combine Addy interview-me one-question-with-hypothesis and outcome/user/why-now/success/constraint/scope restate with Matt dependency-aware frontier and recommended answers; choose cadence proportionally. Facts investigated; material user decisions await answer. No invented 95% certainty or rejection of ordinary clear authorization.
canonical_comparative_decisions.specification: Combine Addy conditional capability map, stable IDs, acyclic dependencies, exact factual commands/project conventions/testing/boundaries and live scope updates with Matt synthesis of already-settled conversation, high public seam catch/miss tradeoffs and decision-rich prototype snippets. Existing accepted spec and plan remain authoritative; no mandatory terminal-turn ceremony or duplicate files.
